- [ASSISTANT_SAID] James was a leading figure in the Socialist Workers Party in the United States and later the Revolutionary Socialist League in Britain.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "Beyond a Boundary" is regarded as a classic of both sports literature and postcolonial studies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] James was involved in the Pan-African movement and collaborated with figures like Kwame Nkrumah and Julius Nyerere.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] James played a key role in organizing the 1945 Pan-African Congress in Manchester, England.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] C.L.R. James continued to write and lecture in the 1960s and 1970s and died in London in 1989 at the age of 88.
